subject: Phase 100720: CLI `-o` alias for `--output` and output-mode help
verdict_justification: The `-o` alias is implemented and honored at every `--output` recognition site, the output-mode rule is documented, fail-closed behavior is preserved, and all gates pass with independently reproduced evidence. Only minor documentation-accuracy issues remain; no functional defect was found.

metadata.source: crates/clio-lib/src/cli_args.rs, cli_output.rs, main.rs, cli_help_usage.rs and their tests; tests/output_alias_harness.rs; phase doc; make test/lint/coverage

standard: Phase 100720 acceptance criteria AC-100720-01..06 and test scenarios T100720-01..09
requirement.md §4.9.2 item 2 (binding syntax may differ; names and semantics must not change)
Output-mode rule unchanged: explicit flag wins, else text on TTY and JSON when piped
Fail-closed rejection of unknown single-dash tokens must be preserved
Every Rust file <=450 total lines; new/modified files use the AGENTS.md header
Per-file >=90% line and function coverage; aggregate >=90%
No roadmap/private references in public files

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-01: `-o` behaves identically to `--output` at every recognition site
requirements.evidence: git diff adds `-o`/`-o=` handling in cli_args::parse, cli_args::split_leading_globals, cli_output::explicit_output, and main::parse_flags. Real binary: `recall coffee -o json`, `--output json`, `-o=json`, and before-verb `-o json` all exit 0 with the same JSON envelope; `status -o json` emits JSON.

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-02: unknown single-dash tokens still fail closed
requirements.evidence: Real binary `recall coffee -x` -> exit 2, `{"message":"unknown flag \`-x\`"}`; `-ojson` -> exit 2 unknown flag. Tests `attached_short_output_alias_fails_closed`, e2e `-x` assertion.

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-03: output-mode rule documented in help, lists `-o`
requirements.evidence: `clio help` prints `Global flags: --db --backend --bank --actor --output (-o)` and the output-mode paragraph with all four forms. `help_documents_the_output_mode_rule_and_short_alias` pins it.

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-04: per-verb usage decision made and applied consistently
requirements.evidence: Decision recorded: leave 62 usage lines on canonical `[--output json|text]`. Independently counted 62 entries and exactly 8 not ending in the suffix. Pin test `verb_usage_lines_keep_the_canonical_output_spelling`.

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-05: no payload or default change
requirements.evidence: resolve_output/stdout_is_tty untouched; `make check` passed 571 clio bin tests plus workspace suites; existing --output tests unchanged and green.

requirements.requirement: AC-100720-06: no regression; size/coverage gates pass
requirements.evidence: `make coverage` exit 0: 324 files, TOTAL lines 97.96% / functions 98.85%, all per-file >=90%. Touched production files: cli_args.rs 99.00/100, cli_output.rs 100/100, main.rs 99.05/100, cli_help_usage.rs 100/100. All touched Rust files <=450 lines (max 391).

requirements.requirement: New/modified Rust files use the AGENTS.md header with truthful ownership
requirements.evidence: Both new files carry the header; cli_read_output_tests.rs:11 names `run_with_state` although the module only calls the `run_state` helper (imported at line 26).
requirements.correction_needed: Restate the Owns bullet in terms of `run_state` (or remove the function name).

requirements.requirement: No roadmap/private/phase references in public files
requirements.evidence: `git diff --cached` grep for roadmap|clio-private|100720|phase-[0-9] returned none.

findings.title: New test module header names a helper the module never calls
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/cli_read_output_tests.rs:11 says the module owns `Assertions over \`run_with_state\``, but the file imports and calls `run_state` (line 26) and never references `run_with_state`.
findings.requirement_ref: private AGENTS.md File Header (ownership statements MUST accurately describe the module)
findings.recommendation: Change the Owns bullet to name `run_state` (the helper actually exercised); no code behavior changes.

findings.title: Phase Definition of Done marks downstream approval as obtained before it happened
findings.evidence: Phase doc DoD line `Required approval is obtained (downstream pipeline step)` is checked [x], but Adversary/Remediator/Remedy Approver stages have not run and their Attribution rows are still [TBD] (git-staged phase file).
findings.recommendation: Leave that checkbox unchecked until the approval stage completes, or annotate it as pending.

issues.title: New test module header names a helper the module never calls
issues.why_it_matters: The repo mandates that each file header's ownership statements accurately describe the module; a wrong helper name misleads future maintainers about what the file exercises.
issues.impact: Documentation-only; no behavior or test effect.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/cli_read_output_tests.rs:11 vs import at line 26 (`use crate::cli_read_test_support::{json_of, run_state, seed_item, state};`).
issues.proposed_fix: Reword the Owns bullet to `Assertions over \`run_state\` for output modes and the recall text view`.

issues.title: Phase DoD marks downstream approval as obtained before it occurred
issues.why_it_matters: A checked DoD box is completion evidence; checking an approval item before the approval stage runs overstates phase completion.
issues.impact: Procedural/evidence accuracy only; the code gates themselves pass.
issues.evidence: Phase doc Definition of Done: `- [x] Required approval is obtained (downstream pipeline step)`, while Remediator / Remedy Approver / Finalize attribution rows are [TBD].
issues.proposed_fix: Uncheck the approval item until the approval stage completes, or mark it `[ ] pending downstream approval`.

dismissed: Possible `-o`/`--output` divergence when the next token starts with a single dash (parse accepts `-x` as a value, main::parse_flags does not): this mirrors the pre-existing long-flag behavior exactly and is not introduced by this change; resolve_output still rejects the bad value with exit 2.

Attached short value `-ojson` not accepted: the phase explicitly allows mirroring only the forms the long flag supports (space and `=`), and it is recorded as a known limitation, not claimed as implemented.
Per-verb usage lines and the `clio status` usage line do not print `-o`: documented decision consistent with treating `-o` as one global flag documented once in the catalog.
Reserved surfaces (`ops`, `mcp`, `retention`, `compose`) ignore `-o` like they ignore `--output`: pre-existing and tracked as open issue #25, out of this phase's scope.

verification.claim: `-o`/`-o=` produce the same JSON as `--output` on the real binary
verification.source_note: Rebuilt target/debug/clio from the staged tree and ran remember+recall with all four spellings; identical envelopes (timing fields differ).

verification.claim: Unknown short tokens still fail closed with exit 2
verification.source_note: Real binary: `-x` and `-ojson` both exit 2 with the usage envelope; bare `-o` exits 2 with `flag \`-o\` requires a value`.

verification.claim: Workspace tests, clippy, and fmt pass
verification.source_note: `make check` completed through all workspace test binaries and doc-tests with no failures.

verification.claim: Coverage gate passes per-file and aggregate
verification.source_note: `make coverage` exit 0; guard: 324 files, TOTAL lines 97.96% / functions 98.85%, all files meet the 90% floor. Baseline /tmp/cov-baseline.json was 97.95/98.85; no touched file regressed (cli_args 98.91->99.00, main 96.97->99.05).

verification.claim: 62 usage entries, 8 without the output suffix
verification.source_note: Independent parse of cli_help_usage.rs: 62 `usage: clio` literals, 8 do not end in `[--output json|text]`.

verification.claim: `clio status -o json` and `-o=text` select modes like `--output`
verification.source_note: Real binary status runs: `-o json` JSON envelope exit 0; `-o=text` `clio status: healthy`; `-o xml` exit 2.

unknowns.what: Whether the median user expects attached `-ojson` to work
unknowns.why_unknown: No user research or issue asking for it; the phase chose minimal handling.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A follow-up CLI phase adding a short-flag framework; already listed as a known limitation.
unknowns.materiality: Low; behavior is fail-closed and documented.

strengths: Alias handled at all four real recognition sites, including the non-obvious `main::parse_flags` used by `clio status`.
Fail-closed semantics preserved and explicitly pinned by both unit and real-binary e2e tests.
Pre-existing 454-line cli_read_tests.rs violation reduced by extracting output-mode tests into a focused, header-documented module.
Coverage floor met per-file with a verified baseline comparison showing no regression.
regrets: The new module header could have been checked against the actual helper names before claiming the file was done.
process_changes: For any new file, verify each symbol named in the header actually appears in the file.
plan_1hr: Fix F-01: reword the cli_read_output_tests.rs header Owns bullet to name `run_state`.
Fix F-02: mark the phase DoD approval item pending until the approval stage runs.
plan_unlimited: Add a small shared alias table so future short aliases are declared once instead of at four sites.
Add a negative test for `-o <single-dash-token>` documenting the accepted-as-value behavior that mirrors the long flag.
